v = input().split()
n = int(v[0])
p = int(v[1])
q, r = divmod(n, p)
a = [[] for _ in range(p)]
for i in range(n):
    a[i // (q + 1) if i < r * (q + 1) else r + (i - r * (q + 1)) // q].append(i)
for x in a:
    print(*x)

v = input().split()
n = int(v[0])
p = int(v[1])
k = int(v[2])
c = list(map(int, input().split()))
f = [0] * p
a = [[] for _ in range(p)]
s = 0
m = 0
while s < n:
    z = max(k, -(-(n - s) // p)) if False else k
    e = min(n, s + z)
    t = min(range(p), key=lambda j: (f[j], j))
    for i in range(s, e):
        a[t].append(i)
        f[t] += c[i]
    m += 1
    s = e
print(max(f))
